text:
elaine-sec: Quick check — opening AWS PrivateLink endpoint in dev VPC so mobile-auth can reach model-store. Planning to allow dev VPN CIDR + build agents. Sanity-check SG + redaction plan?

devin-infra: Which dev VPN CIDR? Need to consider outbound for build agents. PrivateLink doesn't automatically handle egress from runners.

tyler-sre: dev VPN is 10.40.0.0/16. If model store is PrivateLink, control plane stays internal. Runners in prod subnets still may egress. Recommend deny-all egress except specific internal endpoints.

elaine-sec: Proposed SG (ingress only):

```
SecurityGroup: sg-0a1b2c3d
Ingress:
  - tcp 443 from 10.40.0.0/16  # dev VPN
  - tcp 443 from 18.204.0.0/22 # build agents
Egress: deny all, allow to PrivateLink endpoints
```

maria-security: Logging notes: redact keys/tokens and pod/container ids. Logs must be structured JSON and pass through redaction filter before shipping. Also drop full request payloads for health checks.

elaine-sec: Pipeline: app -> stdout JSON -> sidecar filter -> firehose -> kinesis -> splunk. Example rules:

```
redaction.rules:
  - pattern: (?i)(api_key|token|access_key)\s*[:=]\s*"?([A-Za-z0-9\-_=]+)"?
    replace: "$1=REDACTED"
  - pattern: pod_id
    replace: "pod=REDACTED"
```

tyler-sre: Use named capture and mask to 8 chars instead of full redact so debugging still possible. Also ensure pii-tagged logs go to restricted index. Need IAM role on model-store side to allow kinesis:PutRecords from our account.

devin-infra: I'll add the IAM role to the PR. Limit build-agent ingress to specific IPs where possible; if not, prefer peering or transit gateway for runners.

elaine-sec: We have additional ranges: 18.204.0.0/22 plus 3 more — adding to PR. Do we need security approval to create in dev?

maria-security: Small/medium risk, approve in dev once redaction tests run in CI and SG uses least privilege. Prod needs CR with runbook and rollback.

devin-infra: Also use aws_vpc_endpoint_service_allowed_principals to restrict the PrivateLink to our account id and tag resources owner=dev-team.

deploy-bot: Audit SECD-482 created for PrivateLink dev endpoint by elaine-sec at 1800123456

tyler-sre: LGTM after tag change. :thumbsup:

elaine-sec: Merging now. I'll post when endpoint and logs show up in Splunk.
